title: Initiative member-item strategy
description: The configuration for how an initiative coordinates work across its member backlog items. This REPLACES the phase-less `item-level` operating mode (EXECUTION-MODES.md D7): member-item coordination is domain workflow STRATEGY CONFIGURATION carried on the initiative's workflow instance, NOT an operating mode and NOT a target kind. There is no noun+verb target here — the strategy simply says which per-item operation to run and how to schedule items. A true phase-graph initiative loop (holistic-loop) remains an operating mode with an `initiative` target; this document is the alternative for the common 'run each item through its own operation' case that item-level used to express as a degenerate mode.

strategy.description: parallel-items = advance eligible items concurrently up to max_concurrency (the item-level default). sequential-items = one item at a time in list order. prioritized-items = one item at a time in priority order.

item_operation.description: The operation contract id run per member item (e.g. execution-run). Bound to a mode per item via the normal layered-binding precedence; the strategy only names the operation, never a mode or implementation.

max_concurrency.description: Upper bound on concurrently-advancing items for parallel-items. Ignored for the sequential strategies. Absent means unbounded parallelism.

stop_on_first_failure.description: When true, a failed member item halts scheduling of further items until an operator intervenes.

item_selection.description: Which member items the strategy schedules: every eligible item, or only items in a ready state.
